title: MME crash and restart
body:
Hi Sukchan

I've got Open5GS running on the live testbed network now, and everything is working well; apart from the MME. For some reason, it seems to crash pretty regularly and is auto restarted by systemd. After the crash, UEs take a short time to reconnect as existing sessions become stale etc, so it is affecting trialist experience a little.

As I was aware this was happening, I ran the MME with debug logging switched on, to see if this would catch the problem, but I cant see anything obvious. In the logs attached below, the crash occurs at`11/25 14:36:50` and restarts completes at `11/25 14:36:53`. As you can see, it just restarts in the middle of processing a service request. 

[mme_crash_logs.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/7603901/mme_crash_logs.zip)

Do you have any idea what might be causing this? None of the other core components are failing, and other than slight confusion after the MME restarts, their logs seem to indicate everything is alright!
